name.description: The full name of the BackupPlan Resource.
name.rationale: Resource identification has no direct security impact but is essential for governance and operational management.

cluster.description: The source cluster from which Backups will be created via this BackupPlan.
cluster.rationale: Defines which cluster's data will be backed up. Must reference approved production clusters to ensure backup policies apply to correct workloads.

location.description: The region of the Backup Plan.
location.rationale: Determines data residency for backup operations. Must align with approved regions for compliance with data protection regulations.

retention_policy.description: RetentionPolicy governs lifecycle of Backups created under this plan. Structure is [documented below](#nested_retention_policy).
retention_policy.rationale: Critical for data protection and compliance. Proper retention ensures backup availability for disaster recovery while meeting regulatory requirements for data lifecycle management.

backup_delete_lock_days.description: Minimum age for a Backup created via this BackupPlan (in days). Must be an integer value between 0-90 (inclusive). A Backup created under this BackupPlan will not be deletable until it reaches Backup's (create time + backup_delete_lock_days). Updating this field of a BackupPlan does not affect existing Backups. Backups created after a successful update will inherit this new value.
backup_delete_lock_days.rationale: Prevents premature deletion of backups, ensuring minimum retention period for compliance and disaster recovery. Critical protection against accidental or malicious backup deletion.

backup_retain_days.description: The default maximum age of a Backup created via this BackupPlan. This field MUST be an integer value >= 0 and <= 365. If specified, a Backup created under this BackupPlan will be automatically deleted after its age reaches (createTime + backupRetainDays). If not specified, Backups created under this BackupPlan will NOT be subject to automatic deletion. Updating this field does NOT affect existing Backups under it. Backups created AFTER a successful update will automatically pick up the new value. NOTE: backupRetainDays must be >= backupDeleteLockDays. If cronSchedule is defined, then this must be <= 360 * the creation interval. If rpo_config is defined, then this must be <= 360 * targetRpoMinutes/(1440minutes/day)
backup_retain_days.rationale: Defines how long backup data is available for recovery operations. Must balance storage costs with recovery requirements and compliance obligations.

locked.description: This flag denotes whether the retention policy of this BackupPlan is locked. If set to True, no further update is allowed on this policy, including the locked field itself.
locked.rationale: Prevents unauthorized modification of retention policies after implementation, ensuring compliance requirements cannot be circumvented.

backup_config.description: Defines the configuration of Backups created via this BackupPlan. Structure is [documented below](#nested_backup_config).
backup_config.rationale: Controls what data is backed up and how it's protected. Critical for ensuring sensitive data is properly encrypted and backup scope meets security requirements.

include_volume_data.description: This flag specifies whether volume data should be backed up when PVCs are included in the scope of a Backup.
include_volume_data.rationale: Determines if persistent volume data is included in backups. Critical for complete disaster recovery capability of stateful applications.

include_secrets.description: This flag specifies whether Kubernetes Secret resources should be included when they fall into the scope of Backups.
include_secrets.rationale: Controls whether sensitive configuration data (secrets) is backed up. Must balance complete recovery capability with security risk of backing up sensitive data.

encryption_key.description: This defines a customer managed encryption key that will be used to encrypt the "config" portion (the Kubernetes resources) of Backups created via this plan. Structure is [documented below](#nested_backup_config_encryption_key).
encryption_key.rationale: Encryption is mandatory for protecting backup data containing sensitive information. Customer-managed keys provide better security control than default encryption.

gcp_kms_encryption_key.description: Google Cloud KMS encryption key. Format: projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*
gcp_kms_encryption_key.rationale: Must use approved KMS keys from the same region for encryption. Critical for data protection and compliance with encryption standards.

all_namespaces.description: If True, include all namespaced resources.
all_namespaces.rationale: Determines backup scope. Backing up all namespaces ensures complete recovery but may include sensitive or unnecessary data. Requires careful consideration.

labels.description: Description: A set of custom labels supplied by the user. A list of key->value pairs. Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Essential for governance, security classification, and policy enforcement. Proper labeling enables automated security controls and compliance auditing.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project context for resource creation, typically inherited from provider configuration.
